syllabus_topics: Introduction, definition of technical drawing, introduction to drawing tools and equipment, scales, papers, etc.
Dimensioning, tolerances and surface finish symbols
Introduction to drawing program in computer and introduction to usage options
Arranging the drawing screen, introduction to basic drawing commands
Introduction to basic editing commands in computer, part modeling using basic drawing and editing commands
Using layer commands, using dimensioning commands
Drawing manufacturing drawings of machine parts in sufficient views
Taking sections in modeled parts, adding dimensions, surface symbols and tolerances
Drawing production and assembly drawings on computer, getting printer output
